we have introduced a large database for Arabic handwritten text image recognition and writer identification, and the database is freely available.
we developed an Arabic Handwritten Databases for Text Images written by multiple writers (AHTID) that can be used for recognition, segmentation and writer identification tasks.
we have developed an AHTID/Mw database for Arabic handwritten text images.

a) the construction of a database for Arabic handwritten text images, b) the evaluation of the performance of the state-of-the-art Arabic handwritten text recognizers, and c) the evaluation of different approaches for Arabic handwritten text segmentation.
